spanish: Y pondrás la mesa desde fuera a la parójet, y la menorá frente a la mesa sobre costado del mishkán hacia el sur, y la mesa darás sobre costado norte.

findings.issue: לַפָּרֹכֶת is a common noun with article and preposition; parójet leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
הַמְּנֹרָה is a definite common noun; menorá dumps the untranslated lemma instead of Spanish.
הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a definite common noun; mishkán dumps the untranslated lemma instead of Spanish.
מִחוּץ ל is locative outside-of; desde fuera a can also be read as a path. Both prepositions are in the tokens.
The directional suffix licenses hacia; the article el is unmarked grammatical smoothing.

notes: 2ms qal שים/נתן, singulars, southward versus unsuffixed north, and both construct sides are preserved.
